questions.title: What Is an Exception
questions.description: In Java, what is an exception?
questions.Option1: A compile-time syntax error reported by the compiler
questions.Option2: An abnormal event that disrupts the normal flow of the program at runtime
questions.Option3: A comment that the compiler ignores

questions.description: NullPointerException belongs to which category?

questions.Option4: Checked only when thrown from main

questions.title: try-with-resources Basic Fact
questions.description: In try-with-resources, what happens to a resource declared inside try(...)?

questions.title: getMessage vs printStackTrace
questions.description: What is the difference between getMessage() and printStackTrace()?

questions.Option2: getMessage() returns only the detail message string, while printStackTrace() prints the exception type, message and call stack
questions.Option3: printStackTrace() returns the message as a String, while getMessage() prints it
